title: A Hybridization Chain Reaction-based Method for Amplifying Immunosignals
protocol: Anesthetize mice with an overdose of pentobarbital.
Perfuse intracardially with PBS, followed by paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 4% wt/vol in PBS.
Dissect tissues and postfix them in 4% PFA for 4 h at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Dehydrate tissue samples in a 30% sucrose solution.
Prepare thin tissue sections on a Cryostat microtome.
Wash and permeabilize sections in 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST).
Block sections in 2% BSA in PBST at room temperature for 1 h.
Incubate sections with primary antibodies for various times according to the efficiency of the antibodies.
Wash samples three times in PBST.

If DNA HCR initiator conjugated secondary antibodies are used, incubate samples in HCR amplification buffer (5× sodium chloride citrate (SCC buffer), 0.1% vol/vol Tween-20, and 10% wt/vol dextran sulfate in ddH2O) for 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate sections with biotinylated secondary antibodies or DNA HCR initiator conjugated secondary antibodies.
Wash samples three times in PBST.
For biotinylated secondary antibodies, incubate samples in 1 µg/mL streptavidin at room temperature for 30 min.
Wash samples three times in PBST.
Incubate samples with 0.5 µM DNA-biotin HCR initiators at room temperature for 30 min.
Wash samples three times in PBST.
Snap-cool a pair of DNA-fluorophore HCR amplifiers separately in 5× SSC buffer by heating at 95°C for 90s and cooling to room temperature over 30 min.
Add graphene oxide (GO) to the buffer from step 2 to a final concentration of 20 µg/mL if background suppression is required, then vortex thoroughly.
Incubate samples with the buffer containing amplifiers overnight at room temperature.
Wash samples three times in PBST.
Mount sections on slides and observe.
